rationale: Both registered independent endpoint jobs fit with measured headroom. First sampler already reached actual rollout peak; second starts after training releases memory. Each owns its model, output and immutable saved noise. No unbudgeted probes.
D0: one worker after all 24 new RAW receipts, remeasure before dispatch
CPU: two scoring workers and at most two rendering workers; thread limits 1 each; overlap with independent D0 allowed
timing_scope: Concurrent wall times are not isolated throughput benchmarks
